base.text: After three years redesigning loan onboarding for banks at Deloitte, where my team cut approval time by 30%, I want to build fintech products from the inside.
At Booth, I built a SQL dashboard for the Fintech Club that 300 members use, which taught me to turn raw data into decisions a product team can act on.
I also led our Booth case competition team to a 2nd-place finish out of 40 teams, which strengthened how I prioritize and communicate under pressure.
The {role} role at {company} is where I can combine that analytical background with hands-on product work, and I would welcome the chance to talk.
Thank you for your time and consideration.

practice_feedback.tooShort: That's a little short. Aim for 4 to 6 sentences: one number up front, then the story, then what you'd do next.
practice_feedback.withNumber: Nice, you used a concrete number. Next step: say it in your first sentence, then walk through the story.
practice_feedback.withoutNumber: Lead with one number, then the story. Open with a single clear result (e.g., 30% faster approvals) before explaining how you got there.

rules.feedback: Lead with one number, then the story. For metrics questions, open with a single clear metric (e.g., 30% faster approvals) before explaining how you got there.
Pause for two seconds before answering, and restate the question in one line. Have one opener ready for your top three stories.

reflection_feedback.default: Nice reflection. For next time, pick the one answer you'd improve most and rewrite its first sentence so it states your result up front.
